items.title: Josh Jacobs: Files civil suit Wednesday
items.text:
Jacobs filed a civil suit Wednesday seeking a permanent injunction restricting access to records from his May 23 altercation with a woman at his home, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Set to practice in pads Thursday
items.text:
Henderson (ankle) is in pads ahead of Thursday's practice, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Week 6 status "up in the air"
items.text:
Brown (ankle) said Thursday that it's "up in the air" whether he'll be available for Sunday's game against the Jets, and that the decision will ultimately be made by head coach Mike Vrabel, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Quinshon Judkins: No activity in open portion Thursday
items.text:
Judkins (foot) was present for Thursday's practice but didn't participate in stretching or individual drills during the portion of practice open to the media, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tanner McKee: Primed for start Week 6
items.text:
McKee appears lined up to start Sunday's game against the Panthers after the Eagles announced Wednesday that Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for Week 6 due to a superficial blood clot on his calf, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
